findings.evidence: Rubric: keep bodies unexposed unless a consumer must unfold or compute. Repo convention reserves `@[expose]` for computable tables (`f4Root`, `b2Index`, ...); grep shows no use of `diagramRootPerm` outside the two new files, and both uses are via lemmas.
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]`; `rationalDiagramAut_indexEquiv` (line 139) already supplies the defining equation.
findings.issue: `@[expose] def diagramRootPerm` exposes the body downstream for no consumer. It is noncomputable, its body is `(rationalDiagramAut ht hσ).indexEquiv` whose head `rationalDiagramAut` is itself not exposed, and every in-repo use (`diagramAut_indexEquiv`, `datumGraphAut_indexEquiv`, `root_/coroot_diagramRootPerm`) goes through lemmas in the same file or through imported lemmas.

findings.evidence: grep for `diagramPerm_mem_diagramSymmetry` in ./code returns nothing. Precedent in the sibling file: `SerreGraphAutomorphism.lean:70 cartanMatrix_submatrix_diagramPerm` names exactly this kind of restatement and every declaration there consumes the name, not the term.
findings.fix: Add `theorem diagramPerm_mem_diagramSymmetry : d.diagramPerm ∈ d.1.dynkinType.diagramSymmetry := DynkinType.mem_diagramSymmetry_iff.mpr d.cartanMatrix_diagramPerm` and use it in all five places.
findings.issue: `DynkinType.mem_diagramSymmetry_iff.mpr d.cartanMatrix_diagramPerm` is spelled out five times (lines 60, 67, 94, 105, 112) and appears inside the public statement of `datumGraphAut_indexEquiv`, so a consumer restating anything must reproduce the raw proof term. The PR description claims `TauCeti.GraphTwistedIndex.diagramPerm_mem_diagramSymmetry` exists; it does not.

findings.evidence: `DiagramAutomorphism.lean:171,236` mark `root_diagramRootPerm` and `coroot_diagramRootPerm` `@[simp]`; Mathlib `LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Hom.lean:689` marks `root_indexEquiv_eq_smul` `@[simp]` in the `root (g.indexEquiv i) → g • root i` direction, which the file's own `datumGraphAut_indexEquiv` pre-empts.
findings.fix: State both in the same shape (both `coroot/root (d.datumGraphAut.indexEquiv k) = ...`) and give both the same annotation — or drop them, since each is one `simp` step from `datumGraphAut_indexEquiv` plus `root_diagramRootPerm`/`coroot_diagramRootPerm`.
findings.issue: The root/coroot pair is stated in two different shapes and annotated inconsistently: `root_datumGraphAut_indexEquiv` is `@[simp]` and phrased with `•` (its name mentions `indexEquiv`, its statement does not), while `coroot_datumGraphAut_indexEquiv` (line 98) is phrased with `.indexEquiv` and is not `@[simp]`. Neither LHS is in simp normal form: `datumGraphAut_indexEquiv` is `@[simp]` (line 64), so simp rewrites `d.datumGraphAut.indexEquiv` to `diagramRootPerm` first and then fires the imported `root_/coroot_diagramRootPerm`, bypassing both lemmas.

findings.evidence: The repo's Lie-algebra analogue has the full set: `Serre/Automorphism.lean:187 eq_serreDiagramAut`, `:197 serreDiagramAut_refl`, `:203 serreDiagramAut_trans`, `:211 serreDiagramAut_symm`. Here only the first two analogues exist.
findings.fix: Add `diagramAut_inv (hσ) : diagramAut ht (t.diagramSymmetry.inv_mem hσ) = (diagramAut ht hσ)⁻¹` (via `map_inv (diagramAutHom ht)`), and `eq_diagramAut {g : (t.simplyConnectedRootDatum ht).Aut} (hσ) (h : g.toHom.weightMap = (LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft ℤ ℤ σ.symm).toLinearMap) : g = diagramAut ht hσ`, which also yields transport along `σ = τ`.
findings.issue: The group API is developed for `one` (line 345) and `mul` (line 352) but stops there: there is no `diagramAut_inv`/`diagramRootPerm_inv` even though `diagramSymmetry` is closed under inverses, and no uniqueness lemma identifying an automorphism with `diagramAut` from its weight map — although `weightHom_injective` is already the proof technique used twice in this file.

summary: The construction and its characteristic lemmas (indexEquiv, weightMap, coweightMap, root/coroot coordinates, multiplicativity, order relation) are in good shape, but the surface has four defects: an unjustified `@[expose]`, a missing named membership lemma promised by the description, an inconsistent root/coroot pair in the CFSG file, and a missing inverse/uniqueness half of the group API.
